Amelia CSM: Heads up 1 Theta submitted a request to onboard a 14B contract summarizer (theta-legal-14b). They require BYOK (AWS CloudHSM), US-WEST-2 residency, 90d audit log retention, and an eval on their 5k contract corpus. They9d like a pilot in ~3 weeks.

Rafael Sec: Clarify: BYOK via CloudHSM with customer-managed keys, right? If so we need their CloudHSM cluster details, certificates, and a network diagram.

Amelia CSM: Yes BYOK CloudHSM. I'll ask for cluster endpoint + SOC certs and a sample network diagram.

Li Safety: For safety gating we need to run: PHI/PII extraction recall, redaction robustness, hallucination on legal Q&A, and instruction-following tests. Can they provide 200 de-id docs as a holdout? If not, we can synthesize. Label eval: theta-legal-safety-v1.

Jon ML: Model details? Are weights PT? Any opt states? Quantization preference? If PT we can run staging evals; quant later.

Amelia CSM: They said PT weights, finetuned, no optimizer states shared. No built-in redaction.

Priya Eng: Quick infra notes: assuming peak ~40 rps, avg ~10 rps and p95 <350ms (asked by customer) we can target Dedicated medium GPU with prefix KV caching. Rollout plan: security intake (0-3d) -> staging deploy + eval (4-9d) -> canary ramp (10-14d) -> pilot monitor (15-21d). Tight but possible if HSM onboarding isn't blocked.

Maya Infra: For CloudHSM BYOK we need TOC:
- Customer CloudHSM contact + endpoints
- TLS certs and mutual TLS plan
- VPC peering / private link design
- Key rotation cadence
We'll prepare our HSM proxy docs.

Rafael Sec: Also need their SOC/ISO docs, data flow diagram, and retention policy signed off. Add to ticket.

OpsBot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-ONBOARD-7007 1 Theta CloudHSM + security intake. https://redwood.example/tickets/REDWOOD-ONBOARD-7007 :white_check_mark:

Li Safety: I'll draft the eval checklist and share in this thread. CSM, please request 200 de-id docs and a 50-sample high-risk Q&A set from Theta.

Amelia CSM: On it. I'll set weekly checkpoints with Theta and mark account health as "watch" (renewal Aug 2026) until security gating is complete.

Priya Eng: Action items: Maya prepare HSM proxy docs, Jon prep staging infra and eval harness, Li draft safety bench, Rafael gather security checklist items, Amelia request artifacts from customer. We'll aim to confirm pilot feasibility by EOW.

Amelia CSM: Enablement call scheduled Tue 10am PT with Theta infra + security. Will post notes afterwards.
